name: Balduvian
description: A barbarian people led by chieftain Lovisa Coldeyes.

description_citations.text: Deckmasters: card flavor text (Deckmasters, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lovisa Coldeyes vows the Balduvians would sting their enemies even in ash.
timeline.quote: "Were they to reduce us to ash, we would clog their throats and sting their eyes in payment."

citation.text: Pillage (World Championship Decks 1997, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
